items.text: SECTION A: SHORT ANSWER ESSAY QUESTIONS (30 MARKS)
ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS. EACH QUESTION CARRIES 6 MARKS.
State six functions of the epidermis and dermis that are important in maintaining body integrity.
Highlight six roles of sweat glands in maintaining normal body temperature and skin health.
Outline six physiological processes involved in heat production within the human body.
Identify six causes of abnormal body temperature.
State six types of sensations that can be felt in the oral and facial regions.
SECTION B: LONG ANSWER ESSAY QUESTIONS (40 MARKS)
Answer Question ONE and any other ONE question (Each question carries 20 Marks.)
